title.ja: チェックイン・荷物超過

prompt: Let's role-play. You're an airline check-in agent, and my suitcase is three kilos overweight. Start by asking for my passport.
hard: Play it strict — don't waive the fee easily.
phrases_en: How much would that come to?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're an airport security officer, and something in my bag set off the scanner. Start by asking me to step aside.
phrases_en: Do I need to take it out?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a flight attendant on a long-haul flight. Start by asking me what I'd like to drink.
phrases_en: Actually, could I change that to...
When you get a chance, could you...

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a border officer at immigration, and I've just landed. Start by asking the purpose of my visit.
hard: Ask me follow-up questions and sound suspicious.

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a baggage claim agent, and my suitcase never came out. Start by asking for my baggage tag.
phrases_en: It's a medium-sized black one with...
What happens if it doesn't turn up?
Can you deliver it to my hotel?
Who do I follow up with?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a taxi driver picking me up at the airport. Start by asking where I'm headed.
phrases_en: Roughly how long will it take?
Could you drop me at the corner?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a subway station attendant, and I don't know which ticket to buy. Start by asking how many days I'll be here.
phrases_en: Which line do I take for...
Do I need to change trains?
Is this ticket good for buses too?
Am I on the right platform?

title.ja: ホテルのチェックイン

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a hotel front desk clerk, and I'm checking in. Start by asking for my name and ID.
phrases_en: Could I get a room away from the lift?
Is there anywhere I can leave my bags?

title.ja: ホテルの部屋のトラブル

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a hotel front desk clerk. I'm calling from my room because the air conditioning doesn't work and it's freezing. Start by apologising.
hard: Tell me the hotel is fully booked and there's nothing you can do.
phrases_en: I'm afraid there's a problem with...
I'd appreciate it if you could...
Is there any chance of moving to another room?
I'd rather not wait until tomorrow.

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a waiter at a busy restaurant, and I've just sat down. Start by asking if I'd like something to drink.

title.zh: 餐厅出事 · 菜错了 / 结账问题
title.ja: 料理の間違い・会計トラブル

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a waiter. You've brought me the wrong dish, and I'm in a hurry. Start by putting the plate down and asking if everything's alright.
phrases_en: Sorry, I think there's been a mix-up.
Could you check the bill for me?
I don't think this is right.

title.zh: 买东西 · 试穿 · 退换

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a shop assistant. I'm looking for a jacket but I'm not sure about the size. Start by asking if I need help.
phrases_en: Do you have this in a...
It's a bit tight around the...

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a pharmacist, and I've had a sore throat and a fever for two days. Start by asking what's wrong.
phrases_en: Is there anything over the counter for it?

prompt: Let's role-play. You work at a phone shop, and I need a local SIM card for two weeks. Start by asking what kind of phone I have.
phrases_en: How much data do I get?
Do I need to register it?
It says no service — any idea why?
Can you set it up for me?

title.zh: 钱的问题 · ATM 吞卡 / 刷卡被拒
title.ja: ATMにカードが吸い込まれた

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a bank teller. The ATM outside just swallowed my card. Start by asking what happened.
phrases_en: My card was declined and I don't know why.
What do I need to bring?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a police officer at a station. My wallet was stolen on the subway an hour ago. Start by asking me to describe what happened.
phrases_en: I noticed it was missing when...
I need a report for my insurance.
Is there any chance of getting it back?

title.zh: 问路（并且听懂对方的回答）

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a local on the street, and I'm lost looking for the train station. Start by asking if I need help.
hard: Give me long, detailed directions with lots of street names.
phrases_en: Sorry, is this the way to...
So I go straight and then turn left?
How far is it on foot?
Could you point me in the right direction?

prompt: Let's role-play. You work at a train station ticket counter. I missed my train and need to get on a later one. Start by asking for my ticket.
phrases_en: Can I change it without paying extra?
Does that one require a reservation?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a guide at a museum ticket desk. Start by telling me the ticket options.
phrases_en: How long does the tour take?
Can I take photos in there?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're another traveller in a hostel common room. Start by asking me where I'm from.
phrases_en: How long have you been travelling?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're my neighbour, and we've just run into each other in the hallway. Start by saying hi and commenting on the weather.
Let's role-play. You're a colleague, and it's Monday morning by the coffee machine. Start by asking how my weekend was.
Let's role-play. You're a friend, and I want to ask you to try a new restaurant this week. Start by asking what's up.
Let's role-play. You're a friend inviting me to a party on Saturday, but I really don't want to go. Start by inviting me.
phrases_en: I'm afraid I can't make it.
Can I take a rain check?

prompt: Let's role-play. You work at a dentist's office. I'm calling to move my appointment. Start by answering the phone.
phrases_en: Do you have anything later that week?
Let me just write that down.

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a doctor, and I've been having trouble sleeping for a month. Start by asking what brings me in.
phrases_en: It started about a month ago.
I've tried..., but it didn't help.
Is that something to worry about?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a hairdresser, and I'm in the chair. Start by asking what I want done.
phrases_en: A bit shorter on the sides.

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a trainer at a gym I've just joined. Start by asking what my goals are.
phrases_en: I usually work out about three times a week.
Could you show me how to use...
My lower back's been bothering me.

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a letting agent showing me a one-bedroom flat. Start by opening the door and describing the place.
phrases_en: Is there anywhere to put a washing machine?
Is there any flexibility on the price?

title.ja: カスタマーサービスに苦情

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a customer service rep. I was charged twice for the same order. Start by asking for my order number.
hard: Keep telling me it's not your department.
phrases_en: I'd like to speak to someone who can...
How long will the refund take?
Could I get that in writing?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a shop assistant. I want to return something I bought last week but I've lost the receipt. Start by asking how you can help.
phrases_en: I paid by card, if that helps.
Is store credit the only option?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a friend, and I forgot your birthday dinner last night. Start by sounding a bit hurt.
phrases_en: Let me make it up to you.

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a friend who thinks working from home makes people lazy. I disagree. Start by making your case.
phrases_en: I see what you mean, but...
I'm not so sure about that.
That's true up to a point.

title.en: Telling a story about your day

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a friend, and I want to tell you about something annoying that happened at work today. Start by asking how my day was.

title.ja: ニュースについて意見

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a friend, and we're talking about whether AI will take our jobs. Start by asking what I think.
phrases_en: On the one hand..., on the other...
Where do you stand on it?

title.en: Meeting new people at a party

prompt: Let's role-play. We've just been introduced at a party and don't know each other. Start by asking how I know the host.
phrases_en: So how do you two know each other?

title.ja: 道に迷った観光客を助ける

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a tourist who's lost and asks me for directions to the nearest station. Start by stopping me on the street.
phrases_en: Go straight for about two blocks.
You'll see a... on your right.
Do you want me to show you on the map?

title.ja: テクニカルサポートに電話

prompt: Let's role-play. You're tech support. My internet keeps dropping every ten minutes. Start by asking me to describe the problem.
phrases_en: It happens every ten minutes or so.

title.ja: デイリースタンドアップ

prompt: Let's role-play. You're my team lead running our daily standup. Start by asking me for my update.
phrases_en: I should have it done by...

prompt: Let's role-play. You're my manager in our weekly one-on-one. Start by asking how things are going.
phrases_en: One thing I wanted to raise is...
Where do you see me in six months?
Is there anything you'd like me to do differently?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're my manager, and I want to convince you to let us rewrite our checkout flow. Start by asking me to pitch it.
phrases_en: What would you need to see to say yes?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a director reviewing my numbers, and you don't believe my conversion figures. Start by asking where the data came from.
hard: Interrupt me and challenge every number.
phrases_en: It's up about twelve percent quarter on quarter.
I don't have that number to hand — let me follow up.
The sample size is small, so...

title.en: Pushing back on a senior colleague

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a senior engineer who wants to build this in-house, and I think we should buy it. Start by explaining your position.
phrases_en: Can we agree to revisit it in a month?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're my project manager, and I need to tell you the launch will slip by two weeks. Start by asking if we're still on track.
phrases_en: I want to flag something early.
If we cut..., we could still hit the original date.

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a product manager who keeps adding features to my sprint. Start by asking me to squeeze in one more thing.
phrases_en: Something would have to come out.
Which of these is the priority?
Can we park that for now?
That's a bigger change than it looks.
I can do a rough version by Friday.

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a colleague from another team asking me to take on work I don't have time for. Start by asking me for a favour.
phrases_en: Let's talk again after the release.

title.ja: ブロッカーをエスカレーション

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a manager from another team, and my project has been blocked on your team for two weeks. Start by asking why I've set up this call.
phrases_en: I wanted to raise this before it becomes a problem.
What would help you unblock it?
Can we agree on a date?

title.ja: 他チームにリソースを頼む

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a data engineer, and I need your team to build me a new pipeline. Start by asking what I need.
phrases_en: I know you're busy, so I'll keep it short.
Roughly how much effort would that be?
Where would it sit in your backlog?
Is there a lighter version we could start with?
Who else should be in this conversation?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're leading a postmortem for an outage my change caused. Start by asking me to walk through the timeline.
phrases_en: To stop it happening again, we're...
That was my call, and it was wrong.

title.ja: クライアントとのキックオフ

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a client we've just signed, and this is our first call. Start by introducing yourself and your company.
phrases_en: Let me quickly run through the agenda.
Just so I understand your priorities...
What does success look like for you?
I'll send over a summary and next steps.

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a business stakeholder who says you need "a dashboard", but you're vague about why. Start by telling me what you want.
phrases_en: Help me understand the problem behind that.
Who's going to use it, and how often?
What decision would it help you make?
What are you doing today instead?
So if I'm hearing you right...

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a VP with five minutes, and I'm updating you on my project. Start by asking for the headline.
Let's role-play. You're a hiring manager interviewing me for a senior role. Start by asking me to walk you through my background.
hard: Ask me a hard behavioural question and push back on my answer.
phrases_en: I've spent the last three years...
The project I'm proudest of is...
What drew me to this role is...
Can you tell me more about the team?
What would the first ninety days look like?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a candidate interviewing for a job on my team. Start by asking me what the role involves.
phrases_en: Tell me about a time when...
How did you handle the pushback?
Do you have any questions for me?
We'll be in touch by the end of the week.

prompt: Let's role-play. You're my manager giving me my performance review, and the feedback is mixed. Start with the positives.
phrases_en: Could you give me a specific example?
I see it a bit differently — here's why.
How do we track that between now and next review?

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a recruiter offering me a job, and the salary is lower than I expected. Start by telling me the offer.
phrases_en: Thanks — I'm excited about the role.
I was expecting something closer to...
Is there any flexibility on the base?
What's the full package look like?
Could I have a couple of days to think it over?

title.ja: 部下に厳しいフィードバック

prompt: Let's role-play. You're someone on my team who's been missing deadlines. Start by asking why I wanted to talk.
phrases_en: I want to talk about something directly.
Here's what I need going forward.
Let's check in again in two weeks.

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a colleague in a meeting I'm chairing, and you keep going off topic. Start by rambling about something unrelated.
phrases_en: Can we come back to that at the end?

title.en: Small talk at a business dinner

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a client I'm having dinner with, and we're waiting for the food. Start with some small talk.
phrases_en: Have you been to this part of town before?

title.ja: 会議でついていけない

prompt: Let's role-play. You're a colleague explaining something technical very quickly with lots of acronyms. Start explaining, and don't slow down.
phrases_en: Sorry, could you back up a second?
Just to make sure I follow —
Can you give me an example?
Let me say it back to you and you tell me if I've got it.
